title: Transition from the asking state
statement: For any Boolean word $x$, output word $u$, natural number $i$, and Boolean oracle $o$ on encoded Boolean words, one step of the enumerator from the configuration with output $u$, state asking, and counter $i$ leaves the output and counter unchanged and enters the bit state if $o(\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle)$ is true, and otherwise enters the halted state.
